description: WebSocket console: the dashboard now talks to the server over a single /ws socket (RFC6455 stdlib, token-auth first message, chat ops + live pushes on the same connection) instead of SSE polling, and the server routes /ws through the request handler so upgrades actually reach the WS hub.
features: Single /ws socket per tab: token-auth first message, then chat_stream/chat_answer/chat_cancel/chat_active/chat_frames/ping ops plus live pushes on the same connection.
WS routing fixed: /ws upgrades are detected in the request handler (MSG_PEEK) and served by the WS hub; the dead server-level route was removed.
WS serve hardening: auth-failure cleanup no longer touches uninitialized state.
Version synced to 0.17.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
